description: APIs Netlify Edge Functions block or keep on top of the Deno CLI data, applied by the netlify-edge target. Netlify documents neither its Deno version nor blocked APIs, so the entries come from the production witness: the answer committed as the source file, which reports Deno 2.3.1 and agrees with a Deno 2.3.1 presence probe on every lookup except process.stdin. Netlify blocks subprocesses and file writes outside /tmp. The supported entries are APIs that Deno 2.3.1 has and later Deno releases removed. APIs added to Deno after 2.3.1 are covered by the version note, not by entries. `docs` holds hashes of the Netlify docs sections this data rests on (the API page's runtime environment and supported web APIs, and the limits page), and `bundler` the release and Deno range it was read from; the weekly check compares both.
